nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ a sequence in $G$, and $h, k, i, j$ natural numbers with $j + 1 < k$ and $i \le h$. Then $(h - i)a_j + i a_{j+1}$ is a trivial element of the $h$-fold sumset of $a_0, \ldots, a_{k-1}$.
nodes.title: Adjacent sums are trivial elements

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a linearly ordered additive commutative group, let $h$ and $k \ge 4$ be natural numbers, and let $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ be a sequence in $G$ with $0 = a_0 < a_1 < \cdots < a_{k-1}$ and $a_{k-1} - a_{k-2} = a_{k-2} - a_{k-3}$. Then either $a_i = i a_1$ for every $i < k$, or at least $h - 1$ elements of the $h$-fold sumset $hB$ of $B = \{a_0, \ldots, a_{k-2}\}$ (the set of sums of $h$ elements of $B$) are not…
nodes.title: Equal last two gaps: an arithmetic progression or many nontrivial sums

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a linearly ordered additive commutative group, let $a \in G$ with $a > 0$, and let $k \ge 3$ and $h \ge 1$ be natural numbers. The set $A = \{0, a, 2a, \ldots, (k - 2)a, ka\}$, obtained from $\{0, a, 2a, \ldots, ka\}$ by removing $(k - 1)a$, has $|hA| = hk$, where $hA$ is the $h$-fold sumset of $A$, the set of sums of $h$ elements of $A$.
nodes.title: Sumset of an arithmetic progression with its second-to-last term removed

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a torsion-free additive commutative group and let $h$, $k$ and $\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell + 3 \le \min(h, k)$. For every $k$-element set $A \subseteq G$, the $h$-fold sumset $hA$ (the set of sums of $h$ elements of $A$) does not satisfy $hk - h + 2 + \ell h \le |hA| \le hk - h + 1 + \ell h + (h - 2 - \ell)$.
nodes.title: Rajagopal's family of missing sumset sizes

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a torsion-free additive commutative group and let $h$ and $k \ge 4$ be natural numbers. For every $k$-element set $A \subseteq G$, the $h$-fold sumset $hA$ (the set of sums of $h$ elements of $A$) does not satisfy $hk - h + 2 \le |hA| \le hk - 1$.
nodes.title: A gap in the possible sumset sizes

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ a sequence in $G$, and $h, k$ natural numbers. An element $x \in G$ is a trivial element of the $h$-fold sumset of $a_0, \ldots, a_{k-1}$ if and only if either $k > 0$ and $x = h a_0$, or $x = (h - i)a_j + i a_{j+1}$ for some natural numbers $j$ and $i$ with $j + 1 < k$ and $i \le h$.
nodes.title: Characterization of the trivial elements

nodes.title: Many nontrivial sums when the last gap is a proper multiple of the previous one

nodes.title: Many nontrivial sums when the last gap is not a multiple of the previous one

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a linearly ordered additive commutative group, let $h$ and $k > 1$ be natural numbers, and let $a_0, a_1, \ldots$ be a sequence in $G$ with $a_0 < a_1 < \cdots < a_{k-1}$. Put $A = \{a_0, \ldots, a_{k-1}\}$ and $B = \{a_0, \ldots, a_{k-2}\}$, and write $hX$ for the $h$-fold sumset of a set $X$, the set of sums of $h$ elements of $X$. nodes.title: Dropping the largest element keeps nontrivial sums nontrivial

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a nontrivial torsion-free additive commutative group and let $h \ge 1$ and $k \ge 4$ be natural numbers. For a finite set $A \subseteq G$ write $hA$ for its $h$-fold sumset, the set of sums of $h$ elements of $A$, and write $R_G(h, k)$ for the set of sizes $|hA|$ of $k$-element sets $A \subseteq G$. Then $R_G(h, k) \cap [hk - h + 1, hk] = \{hk - h + 1, hk\}$.
nodes.title: Sumset sizes between $hk - h + 1$ and $hk$

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $h$ a natural number and $a \colon \mathbb{N} \to G$. For $k = 1$, when $\{a_0, \dots, a_{k-1}\}$ is the one-element set $\{a_0\}$, the set of trivial elements of its $h$-fold sumset is exactly $\{h a_0\}$, where $h a_0 = a_0 + \dots + a_0$ is the $h$-fold sum of $a_0$.
nodes.title: Trivial elements of a one-element set

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an additive commutative monoid, $h$ a natural number and $a \colon \mathbb{N} \to G$. For $k = 0$, when $\{a_0, \dots, a_{k-1}\}$ is the empty set, the set of trivial elements of its $h$-fold sumset is empty.
nodes.title: No trivial elements for $k = 0$

nodes.title: Trivial elements of an $h$-fold sumset

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
